title: World Commerce Corporation founded 1945
summary: Jason Simosa tells of World Commerce Corporation founded 1945, about 1945 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There is an organization which is created initially in 1945 and it's called the World Commerce Corporation. On the board, Donovan, Stephenson, Ambrose, Dulles [music] doing the legal counsel.
there is an organization which was created initially in 1945 and then rebranded in '47. It's called the World Commerce Corporation.
tellings.difference: Adds the 1947 rebranding, places it in Panama, and credits Hambro, Levenda and Peter Dale Scott; Ambrose is not mentioned.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the World Commerce Corporation, founded in 1945 with Donovan, Stephenson and Dulles involved.

plain: A researcher, Jason Simosa, says that in 1945 a company called the World Commerce Corporation was set up, with a board that included men named Donovan, Stephenson and Hambro, and with Allen Dulles as legal counsel. In one telling he adds that it was rebranded in 1947 and places it in Panama, crediting the writers Peter Levenda and Peter Dale Scott, while in another he lists a man named Ambrose on the board and ties in the inventor Townsend Brown. He tells it to show a private network of wartime intelligence figures that, if real, could have handled secret matters outside government view.
